sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1423 of 2022
Applicant :- Kuldeep Kumar Diwedi

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- O.P. Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Poornendra Kumar Awasthi,Vineet Kumar Mishra
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in FIR bearing Case Crime No. 310 of 2017, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 IPC, Police Station Safipur,
District Unnao.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis on an FIR lodged on 07.05.2017 against two persons, including the applicant, alleging that the co-accused Deo Kishan Tiwari, who was working as a Principal of Badri Prasad Higher Secondary School, which was managed by the informant's father Bhagwat Prasasd Bajpai, has illegally taken the school in his possession.
4. The FIR states that a new managing committee of the school has been formed illegally and that the applicant is the Vice Chairman in the aforesaid committee.
Kuldeep Kumar Diwedi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

entities.text: Kuldeep Kumar Diwedi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The applicant was granted interim bail by means of an order dated 01.09.2022 and notice was issued to the informant-opposite party no. 2.
The learned AGA was granted time to file counter affidavit.

Although Sri Poornendra Kumar Awasthi and Sri Vineet Kumar Mishra have put in appearance on behalf of opposite party no. 2, no counter affidavit or application for vacation of interim order has been filed by them.
6. The State has filed counter affidavit but nothing has come to light which may persuade this Court to take a view different from the view taken at the time of passing of the order dated 10.09.2022.
7. Learned AGA as also the learned counsel for the informant could not pointed out any violation of the conditions of interim anticipatory bail committed by the applicant.
8. In view of above, the interim order dated 10.09.2022 is made absolute and the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Pradeep/-
